roleLabel: Dual Vanguard/Tank anchor — Fault Line Shields, Max HP smash, and frontal Stun
bestFor: Red Rift / hard content that needs a true first-contact wall with Stall scaling
strength: Dual-class pool plus Fault Line that converts Max HP/Defense into Shield, damage, and Stun
weakness: Low flashy clear alone — needs a carry behind the wall

howToPlay.early: Premier opener tank. Buy Max HP and Defense. Cast Fault Line into the engage lane every fight.
howToPlay.mid: Tectonic/Fault Line path = personal smash identity. Protector = auto-attack Shields and Shield-based bonus damage. Friend = Stall permanent Max HP/Defense shared to Tanks/Vanguards on Backup. Pick selfish wall, Shield attacker, or tribal Stall tank.
howToPlay.late: Defensive amplifiers and Tank/Vanguard banners. Keep Stall triggers flowing for Hearty/Friend.
howToPlay.positioning: True front-center facing the pack. Fault Line hits enemies in front — aim the facing, not a side wing.

abilityNotes.Fault Line: Shield first, then Max HP/Defense-scaled smash + Stun in front. He is a door, not a backline caster.

specNotes.The Tectonic: Fault Line / Hearty frontline identity — default when Rowan is your main wall.
specNotes.The Protector: Shield-on-auto path that turns Shields into bonus damage. Take when he can keep attacking safely.
specNotes.The Friend: Stall tribal Max HP/Defense for Tanks/Vanguards. Take with multiple frontliners.

relicReasons.defensive-amplifier-2016: Max HP/Defense amp for Fault Line scaling.
relicReasons.vanguards-rally-banner-538: Vanguard half of his dual identity when Rush/Rally appears.

faq.question: Is Rowan good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: One of the best pure anchors for high difficulty. Not a solo win condition. Buy him to stop dying, then add damage.

faq.question: What class is Rowan?
faq.answer: Vanguard / Tank dual-class. Role focus: defensive anchor with frontal Stun.

faq.question: What relics work with Rowan?
faq.answer: Defensive amplifiers, Tank Absolution/Intercession pieces, and Vanguard Rally when on that half of the kit.

faq.question: How do you play Rowan?
faq.answer: Face the engage, stack Max HP/Defense, cast Fault Line, and specialize toward Tectonic wall, Protector Shields, or Friend tribal Stall.

tips: If Stun never hits, he is facing the wrong way — rotate before rerolling relics.
Friend without other tanks/vanguards is usually worse than Tectonic/Protector.
